purpose: Teach: プロレタリアート/ユニバーサル/中日/ヘクタール/コンプレックス/アンチ/電脳/乙女

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、プロレタリアート文学の戦後史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you focused your paper on the postwar history of proletarian literature, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle confirmation with a question lilt. Warm and professorial. Acknowledging his work without presumption. Calm, steady pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ユニバーサルデザインの普及研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote my paper on the dissemination of universal design.
lines.style: Clear and direct response. Slight pause after the affirmative. Focused tone, as if correcting a misunderstanding without making it awkward. Steady.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、中日関係の外交史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered the diplomatic history of Sino-Japanese relations in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured tone. A gentle reframing, as if inviting him to share what he actually wrote. Slight emphasis on the question itself—curious, not accusatory.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、農地のヘクタール換算法の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote my paper on hectare conversion methods for agricultural land.
lines.style: Polite correction delivered without defensiveness. Brief pause before the dash. Quiet confidence in his own topic. Even, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 現代人のコンプレックス研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You approached contemporary psychological research on human complexes in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged and interested. Open phrasing that invites a response. Warm regard for his intellectual work. Moderate pace, genuine curiosity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、アンチエイジング医学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote my paper on anti-aging medicine.
lines.style: Straightforward affirmation with quiet composure. Minimal hesitation. Factual but not flat—he knows what he's talking about.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、サイバー空間の電脳社会論を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper dealt with cyberspace and digital society theory, didn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful and reflective tone. A slight pause before the question mark. Professional curiosity—genuinely wondering what direction his thinking took. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、近代日本文学の乙女像を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote my paper on the image of the maiden in modern Japanese literature.
lines.style: Final, clear response. Slight vocal closure on the period. Earnest but gently definitive, as if concluding the exchange. Composed and settled.
